description: jQuery Form Plugin version 4.3.0, providing AJAX form submission and form manipulation utilities, including ajaxSubmit and ajaxForm methods.

methods.name: ajaxSubmit
methods.description: Submits a form via AJAX, handling file uploads, callbacks, and form data serialization.

methods.name: ajaxForm
methods.description: Automatically binds AJAX submission behavior to forms, with options for delegation and event handling.

methods.name: formToArray
methods.description: Gathers form data into an array of name-value pairs suitable for AJAX submission.

methods.name: formSerialize
methods.description: Serializes form data into a URL-encoded string.

methods.name: fieldSerialize
methods.description: Serializes form fields into a URL-encoded string.

methods.name: fieldValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value(s) of form elements in the matched set.

methods.name: clearForm
methods.description: Clears all input fields within a form.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets form fields to their default values.

methods.name: selected
methods.description: Checks or unchecks checkboxes/radios and selects/deselects options.
